labview-mcp downloads

Release asset downloads and repository traffic for Zuehlke/labview-mcp.

New downloads per day

Deltas between daily snapshots, with our own CI downloads subtracted. Starts the day collection began; earlier downloads appear only in the per-release totals below.

Per release

labview-mcp.zip is what every plugin install and update fetches (and some manual downloads). The versioned zip is manual only. CI estimates downloads made by release.yml and verify-release.yml, one per run.

Repository traffic

Views and clones as reported by GitHub (kept only 14 days there, accumulated here). Clones are mostly CI checkouts and say little about installs.

Counts are requests, not people: updates, reinstalls and retries all count. Raw data: releases.csv, ci_downloads.csv, traffic.csv.
